generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can certify result artifacts whose repository paths are not permitted by its own publication policy, allowing an internally accepted handoff to be structurally unpublishable or unverifiable.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Build artifact metadata and publication allowlists through separate logic, then validate only observed changed paths after publication.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Derive every declared artifact and transport-part repository path and require it to be a subset of allowed result paths before publication.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: The certificate builder must fail closed when any declared artifact or transport part is absent from the result-only allowlist.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The certificate validator must independently rederive declared artifact paths and reject allowlist drift even before a result-only child exists.
